Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are other popular choices, but they too have their limitations and can be restricted in certain countries. Unlike these platforms, sovereign commerce infrastructure solutions like Edge Commerce Stack ($197) don't rely on third-party payment processors, giving creators complete control over their online stores and allowing them to deploy a complete online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

When it comes to restricted countries, Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle all have varying levels of support, but ultimately, they can't provide the level of infrastructure sovereignty that creators need. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure solutions are designed to be accessible to creators in all countries, including those where these platforms are unavailable. By deploying a stack that's not reliant on third-party payment processors, creators can ensure that their online stores are always accessible and can process payments in any country, without being at the mercy of platform restrictions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed, fees, and real costs, Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle all have their own rates and charges. Stripe's payment processing fees range from 2.9% + 30¢ to 3.4% + 30¢, depending on the country and payment method. PayPal's fees, on the other hand, can range from 2.9% + 30¢ to 5.4% + 30¢, depending on the payment method and the country. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure solutions like Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offer a flat 0.5% fee on all transactions, making them a more cost-effective option for creators who need to process large volumes of payments.
Stripe's geographic exclusion list is a deliberate infrastructure decision — not a temporary gap waiting to be fixed.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When it comes to ownership, automation, and delivery, Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle all have their own limitations. Stripe, for example, requires creators to integrate their own payment processing systems, which can be time-consuming and require significant technical expertise. PayPal, on the other hand, can hold funds for up to 180 days in case of an account suspension, rendering it an unreliable choice for creators who need instant access to their funds. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure solutions like Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offer a complete online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership, giving creators complete control over their online stores and allowing them to automate their sales and delivery processes with ease.
